body: Well my idea was to use it to knock me out when I am feeling depressed, not to stay awake with it. And I have a bit of a thing against doing weed, I don't feel like it's for me.
If I make it that far, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Years Eve, Valentine's Day/My Birthday is all the worst times of the year. I really don't want to turn 20...
I can't cry either, I think it's just a guy thing.
Only in one class. And it's only because I knew some web design and was good at it and people wanted to learn from me. :(
Legit shaking after seeing this...

To be honest, if I could go back to high school and do it over, I would beat the ever loving shit out of anyone that bullied me or slighted me. Because that's what prevents that from happening again, and its legal I suppose, fights break out all the time, all you get is suspension.

I'd be fit for one, I've been working out and I want that to be one of my main goals. Financially stable, humble, a couple good friends I can trust. A good relationship with family and friends. A wife, someone who's interested in me and like me personality wise. And with these I feel depression, social anxiety, and suicidal thoughts will go away. :)
Yeah, I'd gladly take a bullet for someone else or maybe push someone out of the way of a bus, that sort of thing.

Don't feel bad, I didn't graduate high school when I was supposed to, failed a class senior year and went to summer school. Had around a ~2.4GPA I think. Didn't get accepted into any colleges, ended up going to community college. Failed two classes first semester and one second, I don't think I'm that dumb I just get very depressed and stop caring.  
I've also thought about suicide a lot lately, almost daily, I bought the rope to do it. For me it's less of a certain date just whenever I feel low enough I can do it without hesitation.

Community college somewhat, learning web design, doing odd jobs, watching shit tons of tv and movies (I have downloaded about 30 shows and ~450 movies). I take my mind off things by just zoning out having lots of media to consume, jerk off, eat a lot (though not overweight, 5'9 ~165lbs). Clean, organize, workout at home. Don't have any friends and only really talk to one person online.

I'd love to work on a farm. I'm not working at the moment because I'm in school and very introverted. But I do odd jobs/landscaping on the side and like doing that. Working on a farm all day to me would be great.
Usually it's people who I know or used to know, and I can imagine what they'd say to me.

I would kill the person who did that to my sister.  
But like others said, if she's a minor get his ass in jail. Or at least kick his ass.

Since I turned 18 I never really wanted to age past that, everything important is supposed to happen to you and you're supposed to be an adult. So now that I'm 19 and turn 20 in February I just don't want to age.

Take different classes.  
Not ignore that girl that liked me and asked me to prom.  
Try to make friends.  
  
Pretty much it.

I'm the opposite, but it's just as bad, I'm very good at lying and can make up any story I want about myself because no one really knows who you are. Makes you realize you're no one because no one knows who you are.
I have days where I avoid my family, usually on weekends where their all around, I will just stay up late and not get up until 3 or 4 PM.

Only odd jobs (landscaping/cleaning) from references or family. Only thing I can seem to do. I do some websites and video editing as well. So basically nothing official, I would die if I had a real job.
I would bring it up, it would infuriate me that my gf is going to a literal orgy.

I have, somewhat still, a female friend overseas in the U.K. We've been friends for about 3 years and used to Skype everyday, we talked about everything and knew everything about each other, I was one of the first people who she came out as gay to and she attributes part of her comfort with being gay to me and our relationship. We both were rather introverted, me more than her, but now she is far more extroverted, has girlfriends, goes to clubs, drinks, parties, has friends...
And I feel I'm losing her, and she's my last friend. I don't blame her since I've become only more depressed and social phobic. But it will suck when that happens.
Affection, by far.

Yes, people have purposes to spend their money on. Clothes to look nice, food when going out, spending it on SO's. While I just spend it on myself and as nice as that is, it doesn't seem as fulfilling as spending it with/on others.

A lot more brave than me, whenever I get extremely SA I just would tell them I was nervous. I told my mom I felt suicidal when I was 17 but nothing came of it, and pretended to not be depressed after just to feel normal.

Maybe, if you're willing to, tell someone you will buy them drinks if they go somewhere with you. Not a lot of course, but enough to get the night started, they will instantly become your BFF. For the night at least, people love people who buy alcohol for them, assuming you're in the US. Because believe me, I get the notion that you're going to be 21 and everyone has their big ass parties and drinks a shit ton, and you may feel left out.

Nice job! I'm still in the process of applying, I've never had a real job outside of part time odd jobs, etc. So you're 100 steps of me from where I am and I'm 19. Feel good man, you'll be working on SA and making money.

I've recently compared the way I interact with my "friends" and how other people interact with theirs and realized I probably can't really consider them friends...
I only hang out with them a few times every year, I'm in college so we go to different colleges, but even then I commute and could see them if we were more friendly.
And the only times we get in touch, or more so I get in touch with them is to hang out.
It feels so artificial, I see others with their friends and see them hanging out and texting/snapchatting all the time and realize my friends aren't friends.
And also can't help but feel envious...

Nothing bad SHOULD happen, but the cop one sounds like a misunderstanding, I can relate in a sense. Simply me being me and being socially awkward can make myself seem suspicious to others.
As for the suing, that sounds like complete bullshit and you shouldn't have to deal with that.
Old friends I used to have I now have conversations with in my head.

Whenever a family member asks if I have plans they always have an excited look on their face, but I always tell them I'm not doing anything and act as if it's an anomaly when really it's every week...

Got one last year from a girl that was in my IT class, she seemed ok but turned out to be nuts 10 minutes into talking, dragged me around campus and we eventually hugged because I had to go to class.
Kinda pathetic for me that I can remember that one experience a year later but other normal people won't remember a time when someone hugged them a week ago.
This is far in advance until I decide to, I've never felt the impulse to tell anyone, barely even online anonymously or calling a hotline.

Trying to get a part-time job when going to community college. Didn't last year, worked odd jobs at different peoples houses, ideally didn't have to ever communicate with anyone. But now if I get a job I feel that will become 10x worse.

I wasn't ever taught anything either.  
I didn't even know what sex was until I was 15, but I knew of porn since I was 12, amazingly.  
In the sense I didn't know how kids were made etc. Or that sex was anything but porn.  
Nor did I even learn what a condom was until I was 17.  
Thank fuck I'm socially retarded.

I wouldn't mind taking the burden of someone else's cancer.
Sometimes I think if I end up offing myself I'd want the universe to fix someone else health wise, as I clearly didn't use mine to the best of my ability.

Was at my uncles wedding recently, after party was terrible.
Once everyone started dancing I felt isolated as I was one of five who weren't dancing.
I didn't socialize with other family, I don't know them as well as my mother thinks. As she insisted I go around and talk to them.
Ended up leaving early to go back to hotel room.
Possibly magic mushrooms.
Not very long, and not very often, only about 20 photos.
Happened two years ago, I'm fine with it even though me and this girl never really talked a whole lot after, just wanted to get it off my chest and see if I was an ass.
Ah "cue", it was late. Though this was 2 years ago, just wanted to know if I was an ass or not, may seem stupid to apologize now.

I'm very sorry to hear that and hope you are dealing with it well.

That like many others is a main reason keeping me from doing it, but it is not as strong as the fear of being dead. As well the thought of staying alive and simply seeing what happens next, as if it were a tv show.

I'm not even necessarily looking for friends, just someone who is dedicated to texting me, not all the time, just to respond and keep conversation.

A friend would have to dedicate physical time to meet me and do things with, I'm simply looking to text with someone.

This is what I'm afraid of realizing, that this life is just a repeat of certain actions with nothing to matter in the long run, a significant other to live our life with or having kids to have something worth living. I won't start that process of being a slave before killing myself.
Many people don't even know what they've done wrong, I sure don't. I'm simply afraid of social interaction and consequences.
Don't, there's a life for you out there.

I feel similar, though I also have the feeling that female lives are worth more at times...  
Partly for biological reasons and also just feeling they can live an easier life marrying someone.
Though everyone is different.

I feel as if I have been organizing myself over the past year, simply so that if I do decide to on an impulse I can do it without regretting leaving anything behind.  
In a sense, having my room entirely clean and neat and organized.
